question: Which group provided the backbone of the Maratha army?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kunbis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Kunbis** were a significant community in the Maratha Empire, often regarded as the **backbone of the Maratha army**.
 
• They were primarily **agriculturalists** and formed the majority of the population in regions ruled by the Marathas. Their agricultural livelihood made them physically robust and suitable for military service.
 
• The Kunbis were deeply loyal to the Maratha rulers, especially to **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**, who encouraged their participation in the military.
